title: 第十八章   入学考试
content_zh:
连续赶了几天的路程，琼霄与老人终于来到了炎黄行省的首府炎城。走到大街上，琼霄就发现有很多各异的人来来往往，还有不少的人马走动着，脸上挂着兴奋朝着和他们同一个方向走去了。

    来到星辰学院的招生地点，琼霄再次愣神了，这人也太多了，而且招生场地内都是来来往往的人。而学院的老师也是来回走动着，脸上呈现着忙碌状态。琼霄与老人走进里面，发现，在他们来之前很显然已经开始测试了，因为有不少失落走出来的人。很显然这都是测试失败的。

    作为星辰大陆北域上最高规格学院，作为六大帝国共同创办的学院，这里有着北域之内最好的师资力量以及丰富的教学资源。

    北域中有着数不清的少年天才都想着进入星辰学院，由于报考的人数太过于庞大，而星辰学院的名额有限，因此星辰学院的录取条件极为严格，只要一个条件不满足，那就会被淘汰。望着不停进出的人流，琼霄紧紧的握了握拳头，他可不想失败。

    来到离他最近的报名处，报名处摆放着一张桌子，桌子后面坐着一名年轻的小伙子，那桌案后的年轻人胸前挂着一个徽章，这可能是星辰学院的校徽。琼霄望着坐在那里的年轻人，心里不免有些惊讶，这看起来比琼霄大不了几岁，可能就是星辰学院的学长，但是那个学长散发出的气势有些太过于强大，相对于范森来说实力更加恐怖！

    “下一个！”话语一落，一位长帅气的男生走了上前，那位年轻人头也不抬的开口问道：“姓名，年龄，修为。”

    “你好！我叫李朗，十六岁，**境中期！”那个男生开口说道。

    “嗯，你可以进去接受考核了！”那位年轻人摆了摆手，便再度开口道：“下一个！”

    时间静悄悄的远去，进去的人越来越多，等待了半天的琼霄终于来到了登记人的面前。

    同样的问题又响了起来：“姓名，年龄，修为！”

    “琼霄，十六岁，**境中期”琼霄答到，琼霄没有透露出他真实的实力，只要能进去星辰学院就行，太早暴露出自身的实力恐怕会引来不必要的麻烦，因此他只是说自己拥有**境中期的修为。

    听到琼霄的回答，原本低着头的他微微一怔，缓缓的抬起头紧紧盯着琼霄，随即开口道：“你确定你有**境中期的实力？”他之所以要问琼霄，是因为他在琼霄身上没有感受到**境中期所拥有的实力的实力，他不是不想相信琼霄，那是因为报考的人数太多，一旦出现谎报的人，不仅会影响学院老师的测试时间，而且还有影响着学院录取的进度，所以他必须严格筛查，**境内有着不同的测试项目，不同境界的人有着不同的考试范围，一旦出了差错，学院就会怪他们工作不力，因此他不能马虎。

    “是的，我的确拥有**境中期的实力，”琼霄自信的说道，那位登记的人之所以察觉不出来琼霄的真正实力，是因为护臂与护膝掩饰了琼霄真正的修为，实力没有达到那种惊天的修为自然无法察觉出来。

    “好，既然你说你有**境的修为，那把**境中期的气势放出来！要不然我就取消你入学考试的资格！”

    闻言，琼霄只是微微一笑，旋即，一股相当于**境中期的气势顿时爆发开来。

    “有意思，尽然能够隐藏自己的气息，”感受着琼霄所爆发出的气势，年轻人嘴角微微翘起，“好了，你可以去参加考核了！”

    听得年轻人的话语，琼霄转身看着陈伯说道：“陈伯，我去参加考核了，放心，我不会让你失望的，我一定会通过入学考核的。”

    “有什么期望不期望的，只要尽力了就好，今年进不了，还有明年呢，”老人有些激动的说道。
content_en:
After driving for several days, Qiong Xiao and the old man finally arrived at Yancheng, the capital of Yanhuang Province.Walking to the street, Qiong Xiao found many different people coming and going, and many people walking around, walking in the same direction as them with excitement on their faces.

Arriving at the enrollment location of Xingchen College, Qiong Xiao was stunned again. There were too many people, and the enrollment venue was full of people coming and going.The teachers in the college were also walking back and forth, with busy faces on their faces.Qiong Xiao and the old man walked inside and found that the test had obviously started before they came because there were many people who came out disappointed.Obviously this is a failed test.

As the highest-level college in the Northern Territory of the Star Continent, as a college jointly founded by the six empires, it has the best teachers and rich teaching resources in the Northern Territory.

There are countless young geniuses in the Northern Territory who want to enter Star Academy. Since the number of applicants is too large and the number of places in Star Academy is limited, the admission conditions of Star Academy are extremely strict. If one condition is not met, they will be eliminated.Looking at the constant flow of people coming in and out, Qiong Xiao clenched his fist tightly, he did not want to fail.

When he came to the registration office nearest to him, there was a table with a young man sitting behind the table. The young man behind the table had a badge hanging on his chest, which might be the school badge of Star Academy.Qiong Xiao looked at the young man sitting there, and couldn't help but feel a little surprised. He seemed to be a few years older than Qiong Xiao. He might be the senior of Xingchen Academy, but the aura exuded by that senior was a bit too powerful, and his strength was even more terrifying than Fan Sen!

"Next!" As soon as he finished speaking, a handsome boy stepped forward. The young man asked without raising his head: "Name, age, cultivation level."

"Hello! My name is Li Lang, I'm sixteen years old and in the middle of the ** realm!" the boy said.

"Well, you can go in and take the assessment!" The young man waved his hand and said again: "Next!"

Time passed quietly, and more and more people came in. Qiong Xiao, who had been waiting for a long time, finally came to the registrant.

The same question rang again: "Name, age, cultivation level!"

"Qiong Xiao, sixteen years old, middle stage of the Perfect Realm" Qiong Xiao replied. Qiong Xiao did not reveal his true strength. As long as he could enter Star Academy, exposing his strength too early might cause unnecessary trouble, so he just said that he had the cultivation of the middle stage of the Perfect Stage.

Hearing Qiong Xiao's answer, he was slightly startled with his head lowered. He slowly raised his head and stared at Qiong Xiao, and then said: "Are you sure you have the strength of the middle ** realm?"There are too many people. Once someone makes a false report, it will not only affect the test time of the college teachers, but also affect the progress of the college's admissions. Therefore, he must strictly screen. There are different test items in the country, and people of different realms have different test ranges. Once something goes wrong, the college will blame them for poor work, so he cannot be careless.

"Yes, I do have the strength of the middle stage of the ** realm," Qiong Xiao said confidently. The reason why the person who registered could not detect Qiong Xiao's true strength was because the arm guards and knee pads concealed Qiong Xiao's true cultivation level. Naturally, he could not detect it if his strength did not reach that shocking level of cultivation level.

"Okay, since you said you have the cultivation level of the ** realm, then let out the aura of the middle ** realm! Otherwise, I will disqualify you from the entrance exam!"

Hearing this, Qiong Xiao just smiled slightly, and immediately, an aura equivalent to that of the middle stage of the ** realm suddenly burst out.

"Interesting, you can hide your aura at all," feeling the aura erupted by Qiong Xiao, the corners of the young man's mouth raised slightly, "Okay, you can go take the assessment!"

Hearing the young man's words, Qiong Xiao turned to look at Uncle Chen and said, "Uncle Chen, I'm going to take the exam. Don't worry, I won't let you down. I will definitely pass the entrance exam."

"What should I expect? Just try your best. If you can't get in this year, there will be next year," the old man said with some excitement.
